subject.title: Feature: trustedWebhooks for Discord — allow specific webhooks to trigger agent responses

question: Should Discord accept a new guild-scoped trusted webhook authority surface, and may that surface map webhook payloads onto a configured Discord user identity?
rationale: The request is narrower than `allowBots: true`, but it gives Discord webhook possession authority to enter agent sessions and the proposed user mapping crosses authorization and session-identity boundaries.

options.title: Approve allowlist only
options.body: Allow maintainers to design an explicit webhook-ID allowlist that can pass the bot-message gate, while deferring or forbidding user impersonation until its authorization semantics are defined.

options.title: Approve mapping with constraints
options.body: Permit `mapToUser` only with strict validation against configured guild users, clear audit behavior, and tests proving it cannot bypass sender authorization or session isolation.

options.title: Decline Discord-specific ingress
options.body: Keep Discord bot-message policy unchanged and direct external automation to the authenticated webhooks plugin or a separate integration instead of adding another Discord config surface.

recommendation.title: Approve allowlist only
recommendation.body: Allow maintainers to design an explicit webhook-ID allowlist that can pass the bot-message gate, while deferring or forbidding user impersonation until its authorization semantics are defined.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Discord preflight policy work makes this the best available owner for the security/product choice.
